title: game.config.json
description: Release config for a boardgames.dallinking.com game. Reference: https://github.com/DallinCreates/dallinking-boardgames-sdk/blob/main/docs/game-config.md

$schema.description: Editor autocomplete only. Removed from the release by the build.

id.description: Your game's ID. Letters, numbers, dashes and underscores. Must match the game you upload to on the Developer page.

version.description: Release version in semver, like "1.0.0". Published versions are locked, so bump it for every release.

name.description: Display name, used when the catalog has none.

sdkVersion.description: Set by `boardgame-devkit stamp` during the build. Don't write it yourself.

subtitle.description: One line that sells the game. Shown on catalog cards, under the title on your game page, and to search engines. Aim for under 80 characters.

description.description: The About section of your game page. Plain text; line breaks (\n) are kept.

tags.description: Tags for your game page, the Explore tag filter and search. Use Title Case, like "Word Game".

gallery.description: Screenshots shown on your game page, first to last.

src.description: Path to an image inside your release, like "gallery/lobby.png". Put the file in public/gallery/. Must be .png, .jpg, .webp or .gif.

caption.description: Shown under the image and used as its alt text.

players.description: Player limits, enforced in rooms. Leave a key out for no limit that way.

min.description: Start stays disabled until this many players have joined.

max.description: New players can't join once the room has this many.

recommended.description: Shown as "best at N" on your game page. Must be between min and max.

averageDurationMinutes.description: Shown as "~N min". Sorts the game into the Explore length filter: under 20, 20-45, over 45.

difficultyToLearn.description: Shown as "Easy to learn" and used by the Explore difficulty filter.

minAge.description: Shown as "Ages N+". 0 means all ages.

languages.description: Language codes for your game's text, like ["en"] or ["en", "pt-BR"].

assets.description: No longer supported. Use cover.png and gallery.
